sources.observation: The inspected CLI requires task/initial-index/policy-seed; no complete Table 1 evaluation ledger was identified. Do not infer total rollouts from the single-episode entry.
The selected four suites use ten-task orderings and per-task initial-state files; an index is not proof of geometric diversity.

Public files implement a Hessian-weight proxy and weight fake quant, protect action_head, and expose OpenVLA-class loading. No pi05/GR00T implementation found in the inspected complete tree. Does not establish faithful requested action-sensitivity method on three backbones.

Official C++ backbones list OFT and pi05; action-guided mixed per-tensor types/AMF require an average-bit and BF16 runtime bridge audit; not a uniform-INT4 alias. GR00T binding not evidenced. README estimates about 50 GB build/scratch.
Inspected public tree is GR00T-focused with DuQuant preprocessing, ATM/OHB configs and LIBERO client. Does not establish pi05/OFT compatibility of our local framework.
Diffusion-specific per-step scaling is part of HoloQ; OpenVLA-OFT has no such diffusion-step axis. No official implementation repository was identified from inspected paper/project links.
